_comment: Short self-assessment for attributes the skill tests don't cover. Answers are the player's own judgement: they are always labelled self-reported, never shown as measured, and not included in OVR. Option scores stay between 45 and 85 on the 40-99 card scale, because a self-rating can't establish elite or very low levels.

PHY.label: Physical
PHY.intro: How your body copes with the physical side of a game.

DEF.label: Defending
DEF.intro: How you defend in real games, not in drills.

questions.text: How long can you keep playing at full match intensity before you need a breather?
In shoulder-to-shoulder challenges, how often do you keep your balance and the ball?
How often do you win headers and jumping challenges?
After a hard sprint, how quickly are you ready to sprint again?
When an attacker runs at you one against one, how often do you stop them?
How often do your tackles win the ball cleanly, without a foul?
How often do you read a pass early and step in to intercept it?
When your team loses the ball, how quickly do you press or get back into position?
